title: Michaella Shanti’s “Cop a Tally” is a bold track of unshakable confidence
htmlContent:
Michaella Shanti is taking the music world by storm with her latest track, "Cop a Tally." This song is impossible to ignore right from the start. The beat hits hard, and Shanti's confident style shines through, making it clear she knows how to grab attention.

Her rap is powerful and engaging, moving seamlessly with the energetic music that keeps you hooked from the first note to the last. "Cop a Tally" bursts with bold words and a strong presence that you can't overlook. Shanti owns the moment, making every line count.

https://open.spotify.com/track/2aK4qu5d2HnNeutc4q8CH0

"Cop a Tally" sends out a message of strength and confidence that sticks with you for a while. It's a track for anyone chasing their dreams and refusing to be held back. With this track, Michaella Shanti shows that she's here to take charge.
